changes.title: Treehouse landing
items: You can land on any treehouse room or branch floor from the treetops.

changes.title: Delete saves
items: Delete a save in Settings → Saves by holding its 🗑️.
Pause and hold Reset everything to delete every save and start a fresh game.

changes.title: Lunge tracking
items: Creatures can turn during lunges, with tracking strength available for species balancing.

changes.title: Pause panes
items: Pause to see sliders on the left and buttons and switches on the right, with the game still visible between them.
